$description: Spacing by role, so layouts say why a gap exists, not just how big it is. Hand-authored.

inset.$description: Padding inside a component or container.

stack.$description: Vertical gap between siblings: tight for related items, loose for groups.

inline.$description: Horizontal gap between siblings in a row (icon to label, chips, buttons).

page-margin.$description: Side margin of a phone screen; tablets and desktops use grid.*.margin.
